defaultUIOpenMode.label: Default Interface Open Mode
defaultUIOpenMode.tooltip: The mode used to open the interface when clicking the tray icon.

isAutoStartEnabled.label: Launch at Startup
isAutoStartEnabled.tooltip: If the application is running with administrator privileges, enabling startup will launch it with administrator privileges after the next system boot. Otherwise, it will launch as a normal user. Changing the executable file name or path will disable startup and requires disabling and re-enabling it.

autoStartAlert.title: Enabling this will modify system configuration. Please disable it before deleting the application, otherwise residual configuration may remain!

isSilentStartEnabled.label: Silent Startup
isSilentStartEnabled.tooltip: The interface will not open automatically after launching the application.

isEnabled.label: Enabled
isEnabled.tooltip: The application considers the user idle after no keyboard or mouse activity exceeds the configured time. All usage time from the start of inactivity until the next keyboard or mouse activity will be counted as usage time for the Idle application.

inactivityThresholdSeconds.label: Inactivity Threshold (Seconds)
inactivityThresholdSeconds.tooltip: The application considers the user idle after no keyboard or mouse activity exceeds the configured time. All usage time from the start of inactivity until the next keyboard or mouse activity will be counted as usage time for the Idle application.

pollingIntervalSeconds.label: Polling Interval (Seconds)
pollingIntervalSeconds.tooltip: The application checks whether the user is idle at the interval specified here.

dayCutoffHour.label: Day Cutoff Hour
dayCutoffHour.tooltip: Defines when a day starts and when it ends on the following day.

timeZoneId.label: Time Zone
timeZoneId.tooltip: The time zone used when displaying statistics.

iconDirectory.label: Icon Directory
iconDirectory.tooltip: Automatically retrieved application icons will be saved in the folder path configured here. Changing this setting will not affect existing icon paths; it only affects newly retrieved application icons, including icons obtained during metadata updates (if the icon changes).

metadataStaleThresholdMinutes.label: Metadata Expiration Time (Minutes)
metadataStaleThresholdMinutes.tooltip: When the application encounters an app for the first time, it retrieves the executable path and icon. The next time it encounters the same app, it checks whether the time since the last retrieval exceeds the expiration period configured here. If it does, the information will be retrieved again; otherwise, the existing information will be kept. Note: If you customize application icons by manually changing icon paths, it is generally recommended to disable automatic updates for that application, otherwise updates may overwrite the custom icon path.

activeUsageSessionAutoSaveIntervalSecond.label: Active Usage Session Auto Save Interval (Seconds)
activeUsageSessionAutoSaveIntervalSecond.tooltip: The interval for automatically saving the current active usage session to prevent data loss caused by unexpected crashes and ensure accurate screen time statistics.

minValidUsageSessionDurationSeconds.label: Minimum Valid Session Duration (Seconds)
minValidUsageSessionDurationSeconds.tooltip: Each time optimization is triggered, session records shorter than this duration will be automatically filtered out and deleted.

usageSessionMergeToleranceSeconds.label: Session Merge Tolerance (Seconds)
usageSessionMergeToleranceSeconds.tooltip: Each time optimization is triggered, records of the same app with an interval shorter than this value will be merged into a single longer record. Note: During merging, any usage records in between will be deleted regardless of whether other usage records exist.

usageSessionOptimizationIntervalMinutes.label: Session Optimization Interval (Minutes)
usageSessionOptimizationIntervalMinutes.tooltip: Session optimization will be triggered after every interval specified here.

iconDirectory.label: Icon Directory
iconDirectory.tooltip: Automatically retrieved website icons will be saved in the folder path configured here. Changing this setting will not affect existing icon paths; it only affects newly retrieved website icons, including icons obtained during metadata updates (if the icon changes).

activeUsageSessionAutoSaveIntervalSecond.label: Active Usage Session Auto Save Interval (Seconds)
activeUsageSessionAutoSaveIntervalSecond.tooltip: The interval for automatically saving the current active usage session to prevent data loss caused by unexpected crashes and ensure accurate screen time statistics.

minValidUsageSessionDurationSeconds.label: Minimum Valid Session Duration (Seconds)
minValidUsageSessionDurationSeconds.tooltip: Each time optimization is triggered, session records shorter than this duration will be automatically filtered out and deleted.

usageSessionMergeToleranceSeconds.label: Session Merge Tolerance (Seconds)
usageSessionMergeToleranceSeconds.tooltip: Each time optimization is triggered, records of the same app with an interval shorter than this value will be merged into a single longer record. Note: During merging, any usage records in between will be deleted regardless of whether other usage records exist.

usageSessionOptimizationIntervalMinutes.label: Session Optimization Interval (Minutes)
usageSessionOptimizationIntervalMinutes.tooltip: Session optimization will be triggered after every interval specified here.
